_title: League & Tournament Maker – Create Tournaments Easily
_description: Create leagues, knockout brackets, and round-robin tournaments in seconds. Track scores, view standings, share results.
hero_desc: Set up leagues, knockout brackets, and round-robin tournaments in under a minute. Enter scores, track live standings, and share results — all from your phone.
feat_desc: Powerful tools for any tournament format, right in your pocket.
feat1_desc: Create round-robin leagues with single or double round support. Customize match settings for up to 20 teams per league.
feat2_desc: Single-elimination brackets for 2 to 32 participants. Automatic bracket sizing with BYE support for uneven numbers.
feat3_desc: Real-time standings with points, goals, wins, draws, and losses. Export as PDF, CSV, or share as a screenshot image.
feat4_desc: Built-in support for football, basketball, volleyball, tennis, and custom sports. Sport-specific scoring rules included.
feat5_desc: No personal data collected. No tracking. Your tournaments stay yours. Full GDPR compliance with user consent management.
feat6_desc: Available in Turkish, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and more.
step1_desc: Pick between league (round-robin) or knockout (elimination bracket) format.
step2_desc: Enter team or player names. The fixture is generated automatically.
step3_desc: Enter match scores as you play. Standings and brackets update in real time.
cta_desc: Download the app and create your first tournament in under a minute. Free to use with optional premium features.
arts_desc: Guides and game ideas around League & Tournament Maker.
